name: phil/incident-mode-bundle
description: phil/incident-mode in Symfony: pause sign-ups, invitations or forms during an attack, with an honest public notice and automatic lifting.

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the table of the incidents to the schema the ORM generates, so that doctrine:migrations:diff writes its migration
suggest.phil/audit-bundle: To write every start, extension and lifting to its tamper-evident trail
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: For the incidents a member started or lifted in the export and the erasure of their data
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes the pages draw — Alert, Badge, Button, Field, Input, NativeSelect, Table, Textarea —, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.phil/ux-kit-shadcn: For the Tailwind look, with the same recipes of the Shadcn kit of the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that start, extend, lift and list the incidents
suggest.symfony/form: For the option suspended_during of the forms
suggest.symfony/messenger: To lift each incident at its end by a delayed message
suggest.symfony/scheduler: For the recurring sweep that lifts the incidents whose message a transport lost
